source: 773 Cries
target: 773 Clamores

source: The pale-white light quickly engulfed the bird-clawed infant’s Paramita, rendering the spread-out wilderness dull and indistinguishable from the surrounding ruined palaces, towers, and corridors.
target: Lux pallide alba celeriter absorpsit Paramitam infanti ungulis avium, reddens desertum latum opacum atque a ruinarum palatiis, turribus, et porticibus circumiectum indistinguibilem.

source: This Paramita lost the features distinguishing the interior from the exterior, effectively withering and dying.
target: Haec Paramita lineamenta, quae inter intus et exterum distinguebant, amisit, deficiens ac moriens.

source: As the bone serpent collapsed, Lumian fell straight down, landing amidst the broken walls and debris scattered across the wilderness.
target: Dum serpens ossium corruit, Lumian recta cecidit, inter murorum fractos et in desertum disseminatas ruinas cadens.

source: With a forceful bend of his waist and a forward flip, he landed firmly, not relying on his burning‐white spear form to avoid the damage from such a fall.
target: Per vehementem flexionem lumbi et saltum praevium, firmiter terram contigit, non innitens formae hastae alba ardentis ad vabanda damna lapsus.

source: In this pale-white nation, even the rules of the world seemed corrupted; falling from fifty meters felt no different than jumping from a five-meter building.
target: In hac natione pallide alba, etiam leges orbis videntur corruptae; lapsus ab quinquaginta metris non aliter sentiebatur quam saltus ex aedificio quinque metris altitudinis.

source: At this moment, the monstrous child of Oxyto retracted its head into the pale-white flesh sphere, forcing the temperance faction demigod Sharron to detach and hover in mid-air.
target: Hoc ipso momento, filius monstrum Oxyto caput suum in sphaeram carnis pallide albae retraxit, cogens demigodam factionis temperantiae, Sharron, ut se detacheret et in aere suspendi.

source: In the area near the main hall of Death, five or six terrifying undead creatures, influenced by Paramita, shakily rose to their feet.
target: In regione iuxta atrium Mortis, quinque vel sex terribiles creaturae mortuorum redivivarum, Paramita incitatae, vacillanter surrexerunt ad pedes.

source: Among them were two giant serpents with feathered wings and hairy corpses, a bloated, rotten giant, a humanoid mountain of white bones, and a woman with hair like thick snakes and a face two-thirds decayed.
target: Inter eos erant duo serpentes gigantes cum alis pennatis et cadaveribus pilosis, gigas inflatus et putrescens, mons humanoides ex ossibus albis, et femina, cui capilli instar anguilarum crassarum erant, atque cuius facies dimidio corrupta videbatur.

source: Each of these risen dead, summoned by the bird-clawed infant, exerted immense pressure on Knight of Swords Maric.
target: Unusquisque ex his resurrectis, a infante ungulis avium evocatis, pressuram ingentem in Militem Gladii Maric imposuit.

source: As a Sequence 5 of the Prisoner pathway, he knew he couldn’t control these corpses; attempting to wake them would only result in his own immediate dismemberment.
target: Ut Series V viæ Captivi, scivit se harum cadavarum regere non posse; conatus eos excitandi tantum ad propriam promptam dissecationem duceret.

source: The undead, immense and horrifying, locked onto the temperance faction demigod, Sharron, but their movements were sluggish, as if hindered by an unseen force, unable to attack immediately.
target: Mortui, ingentes et formidabiles, in demigodam factionis temperantiae Sharron se coniunxerunt, sed motus eorum lenti erant, quasi vi invisibili obstructi, necnon statim oppugnare nequibant.

source: Sharron, too, could control corpses and command the dead, and she was a true demigod with a higher rank than the premature bird-clawed infant!
target: Sharron quoque cadavera regere atque mortuos imperare poterat, et vera demigoda erat, dignitate superna quam infans ungulis avium praematurus!

source: Sharron’s divided focus to influence the former Blessed of Death gave Oxyto’s monstrous child a chance for rebirth.
target: Intensio divisa Sharronis, ad influendum pristinum “Benedictum Mortis”, filio monstrum Oxyto occasionem renascentiae obtulit.

source: The pale-white flesh sphere bloomed like a flower, revealing a giant baby cleansed by pure water, while the sphere itself withered rapidly, turning pale and decaying as it fell to the ground.
target: Sphaera carnis pallide albae ut flos efflorescebat, revelans magnum infans aqua pura emundatum, dum ipsa sphaera celeriter deficiebat, pallens et putrescens cadens ad terram.

source: Just as the giant baby spread its half-pale, half-chestnut wings, Sharron abandoned her control over the corpses.
target: Justo cum magnum infans alas dimidiis pallidīs et dimidiis castaneīs patefecisset, Sharron imperium suum super cadavera deseruit.

source: In her pale-white eyes, the floating bird-clawed infant was reflected.
target: In oculis eius pallide albis, infans ungulis avium volitans reflectus erat.

source: She opened her mouth and let out a scream that seemed to come from the depths of her soul.
target: Os suum aperuit et clamorem edidit, qui ex intimis animae eius profundis provenire videbatur.

source: The giant baby froze, instantly transforming into a lamb covered in pale fur. Unable to fly or use any Beyonder abilities, it plummeted towards the ground, towards Lumian, who stood with the Sword of Courage.
target: Magnus infans statim congelatus est, in agnum pallide pilis operatum transformatus. Non potens volare aut ullas virtutes Beyonder uti, praeceps cecidit ad terram, ad Lumian, qui Gladium Fortitudinis tenebat.

source: Transfiguration Curse!
target: Maledictio Transfigurationis!

source: Without the monstrous child’s support, Paramita began to collapse.
target: Sine auxilio filii monstri, Paramita corruere coepit.

source: The risen dead lost the foundation of their existence, gradually halting their movements and toppling over in the ruins.
target: Mortui surrecti fundamentum existentiae suae amiserunt, motus gradatim sistentes et in ruinis corruentes.

source: The lamb covered in pale-white fur seemed corrupted from within; as it fell, its skin split, sprouting half-pale, half-chestnut feathers, and its belly swelled, as if nurturing new life.
target: Agnus, pallide albis pilis opertus, intus corruptus videbatur; dum cecidit, cutis eius scissurat, pennas dimidiīs pallidīs et dimidiīs castaneīs oriundas effodens, et venter eius inflabatur, quasi novam vitam nutrit.

source: No creature could escape the fate of being corrupted and nurturing new life, not even an ordinary lamb!
target: Nulla creatura fati corrupti et novam vitam nutrituri evadere poterat, ne quidem agnus vulgaris!

source: This was a trait of the Madame pathway, and the Transfiguration Curse could not strip corresponding Beyonders of these traits!
target: Hoc erat habitus viae Madame, nec Maledictio Transfigurationis talia ingenia correspondentibus Beyonder auferre poterat!

source: Sharron never expected to resolve Oxyto’s premature child with just the Transfiguration Curse.
target: Sharron numquam exspectavit Oxyto puerum praematurum solum Maledictione Transfigurationis resolvi posse.

source: Seizing the opportunity, she let her pale-white figure reflect in the mutated lamb’s eyes.
target: Occasionem capiens, figuram suam pallide albae in oculis agni mutati reflecti permisit.

source: The lamb’s swelling belly began to slow, and the mutation caused by the corruption became less rapid.
target: Venter agni inflatus incipiebat tardari, et mutatio corruptione causata celeritatem amittere coepit.

source: It continued to plummet towards the ground.
target: Continuabat praeceps ad terram cadere.

source: Lumian, standing on the ground, looked up with a smile, raising the blue-hued blazing white Sword of Courage.
target: Lumian, in terra stans, surrexit subridens, gladium Fortitudinis candidum, caeruleo fulgore ignitum, levans.

source: As the lamb entered his attack range, a spear of pure, intense sunlight shot from the half-collapsed tower.
target: Cum agnus in ambitum impugnationis eius intravit, hasta solis purae et intensae e turrim dimidium collapsa proiciebatur.

source: Knight of Swords Maric, enduring significant pain and damage, once again projected the spear that illuminated the pale-white world.
target: Miles Gladii Maric, dolorem et laesiones gravissimas subiens, iterum hastam proiecit, quae mundum pallide album illuminavit.

source: This time, the bird-clawed infant, still in lamb form, could not evade or find a helper to block the spear. It could only watch as the golden spear of sunlight pierced its abdomen and exploded.
target: Hoc tempore, infans ungulis avium, adhuc in forma agni, neque fugiendi vi neque auxilium reperire potuit ad hastam obsistendam; solum intuiri potuit, quomodo hasta aurea solis abdominum eius percussit atque explosus est.

source: At this moment, as the scorching white sunlight engulfed the target, Sharron used Lumian’s eyes and the pure gold in the nearby ruins to Mirror Jump away from the bright, sunlit, and fading pale area.
target: Hoc ipso momento, dum candens lux alba solis scopulum complevit, Sharron oculos Lumiani et aurum purum in ruinis proximis ad saltum specularis adhibuit, se a regione clara, solis illustrata, et pallide evanescente avolvens.

source: Although the lamb’s body shielded her from the direct harm of the sunlight explosion, she, as a spirit-like Beyonder, still suffered significant impact.
target: Quamquam corpus agni eam a directo nocere explosionis solis protegebat, illa, ut spiritus similis Beyonder, tamen ictum gravem toleravit.

source: When she reappeared in a golden pattern embedded in a wall hundreds of meters away, her figure had thinned noticeably, dripping waxy liquid like sweat.
target: Cum in figura aurea, in pariete centum metrorum distante inscripta, reaparuit, figura eius notabiliter tenuata erat, et guttas liquoris cerosi, instar sudoris, stillantes extraxit.

source: Lumian stood close to the pale-white lamb, filled with courage, not dodging, but standing firmly, welcoming the spreading sunlight.
target: Lumian prope agnum pallide album stetit, fortitudine repletus, non evasiens sed firmiter stans, lucem solis expandentem excipiens.

source: Wearing the Eggers family’s golden mask, his entire body ignited, blackening and melting like a candle, bringing extreme pain.
target: Gerens larvam auream familiae Eggers, totum corpus eius incendit, nigrescens et liquescens ut candela, dolorem acerrimum afferens.

source: Fortunately, he was not at the explosion’s core, most of the damage falling on the bird-clawed infant, with Sharron taking some as well.
target: Fortunate, non in centrum explosionis erat, cum pleraque damna infanti ungulis avium inciderent, et Sharron quoque aliqua sustinuerit.

source: Otherwise, the sunlight spear might have purified him in one blow.
target: Alioquin, hasta solis eum uno ictu purificavisset.

source: The Sword of Courage also absorbed half the damage, making his injuries not as severe as they appeared.
target: Gladius Fortitudinis etiam dimidium damnae absorbuit, ita ut vulnera eius non tam gravia videbantur quam apparuerunt.

source: Clenching his teeth, Lumian advanced instead of retreating, running towards the falling bird-clawed infant with the eroded white broadsword in hand.
target: Dentes contrahens, Lumian processit pro non recedendo, currens ad infans ungulis avium lapsum, manu tenens eroditum albidum gladium latiorem.

source: With a faint thud, the half-melted, ghastly pale lamb crashed onto the shattered stones.
target: Cum tenue strepitu, agnus semi-liquescens, horrendum pallidus, in lapides fractos corruit.

source: Lumian arrived a second later, his eyes turning from iron-black to pale-white.
target: Lumian secundo advenit, oculi eius a nigro ferri ad pallide album vertentes.

source: He swung the Sword of Courage with both hands.
target: Gladium Fortitudinis utrisque manibus concussit.

source: Bright white and blue flames flared, the sharp sword striking the lamb’s chest and abdomen.
target: Flammae candidae et caeruleae fulserunt, acutus gladius pectum atque abdominum agni percussit.

source: The explosion was not loud, but the flames and the violent shockwave lifted the surrounding rubble, tearing a jagged hole in the lamb’s chest and abdomen.
target: Explosio non fuit strepitus magnus, sed flammae atque unda violenta ruinas circumjacentes levaverunt, scindentes rupem aspera in pectore atque abdomine agni.

source: Boom! Boom!
target: Tum! Tum!

source: Lumian swung the sword twice more, splitting the bird-clawed infant’s lamb form into charred fragments.
target: Lumian gladium bis iterum volvit, dividens formam agni infanti ungulis avium in frusta combusta.

source: The charred pieces were immediately eroded by the pale-white color, bringing a sense of dark, dead silence.
target: Fragmenta combusta statim ab colore pallide albedo consumpta erant, sensum obscurum et mortuum silentium inferentes.

source: Just as Lumian was about to strike again, the pale lamb’s abdomen exploded, scattering rotten flesh and liquid with a strange aura.
target: Eodem modo, cum Lumian iterum ferire pararetur, abdominum agni pallide eruptum est, carnem putrescens et liquorem cum aura insolita spargens.

source: Instinctively, Lumian slashed the void ahead with the Sword of Courage, cutting through everything there.
target: Instinctu impulso, Lumian gladio Fortitudinis prae se secavit, omnia illuc secans.

source: Boom! Bright white flames and a violent shockwave formed a solid wall, blocking the rotten flesh and evil liquid.
target: Tum! Flammae candidae et unda ictus violenta murum solidum condiderunt, blocantes carnem putrescens atque liquorem malignum.

source: As the pale lamb’s abdomen exploded, a small, phantom figure with bird claws and wings, covered in a layer of pure water, flew out, heading straight for the black bird egg beneath the ancient Death’s corpse.
target: Cum abdominum agni pallide eruptum est, parva figura phantasma, cum ungulis avium et alis ornata, strato aquae purae operta, evanuit, recta versus ovum avium nigrum, pallide albis flammis ardentem, sub antiquo cadavere Mortis volans.

source: This time, the bird-clawed infant, reduced to a phantom, was no longer cautious, no longer circling.
target: Hoc tempore, infans ungulis avium, ad phantasmam redactus, non iam cautus erat neque circumvolabat.

source: Knight of Swords Maric could not throw the spear of sunlight again, as it would cause his severely injured body to dissolve in the light.
target: Miles Gladii Maric iterum hastam solis proicere non potuit, quoniam eo corpus eius graviter laesum in lumine dissolveretur.

source: Instead, he opened his arms, summoning a divine pillar of clean flame from the sky, aiming at the phantom heading for the main hall of Death.
target: Pro eo, bracchia aperuit, columnam divinam ignis puri ex caelo evocans, destinans eam in phantasmam ad atrium principale Mortis tendentem.

source: The bird-clawed infant’s figure first disappeared, then reappeared, evading the divine pillar’s attack, but was immediately locked by Sharron’s pale-white eyes.
target: Figura infanti ungulis avium primum evanuit, deinde re-apparuit, impetum columnae divinae eludens, sed statim ab oculis pallide albis Sharronis inclusa est.

source: Sharron transformed into a dim, stiff doll, encasing herself in layers of ice.
target: Sharron in pupam obscuram ac rigidam transformata, se in stratis glaciei involvit.

source: Simultaneously, layers of crystalline ice emerged around the bird-clawed infant, briefly fixing it in place, preventing its disappearance or progress.
target: Simul, strata glaciei crystallinae circa infans ungulis avium ortae sunt, eo ad tempus firmiter fixum, eius evanitionem vel progressum prohibentes.

source: The bird-clawed infant raised its head, letting out a howling wail within the ice cage.
target: Infans ungulis avium caput sublevavit, in cavea glaciei ululans lamentum edens.

source: The ice cage silently shattered.
target: Cavea glaciei silentio confracta est.

source: The bird-clawed infant’s body, covered in clear, pure water, splashed towards the ancient Death’s corpse, forming droplets of faint golden liquid.
target: Corpus infans ungulis avium, opertum aqua pura et clara, versus anticum cadaver Mortis pluvit, formans guttae liquoris aurei pallidae.

source: These droplets, drawn by an unseen force, converged into a river, carrying the bird-clawed infant towards the black bird egg burning with pale-white flames.
target: Hae guttae, vi invisibili trahitae, confluunt in flumen, infans ungulis avium vehentes versus ovum avium nigrum, pallide albis flammis ardentem, portant.

source: Seeing this, Lumian instinctively wanted to avoid the Phoenix Ancestor’s corpse. He leaned back, raised his arm, and hurled the Sword of Courage.
target: Hoc videns, Lumian instinctu cupivit cadaver Phoenix Antecessoris vitare; se recedens inclinavit, brachium sublevavit, et gladium Fortitudinis iaculatus est.

source: The broadsword, eroded to pale but blazing with white and blue flames, flew like a conscious missile, covering hundreds of meters, leaving a trail of flames in the air, and striking the bird-clawed infant.
target: Gladius latius, ad pallidum eroditus sed flammis albis et caeruleis ardentibus, quasi telum conscientem volavit, centena metrorum percurrens, vestigia flammarum in aere relinquit, et infans ungulis avium percussit.

source: Locked on!
target: Ad scopum intentus!

source: Rumble!
target: Fragor!

source: The sky near the black bird egg erupted with expanding white flames, forming a mushroom cloud.
target: Caelum iuxta ovum avium nigrum flammis albis expansis eruptum est, nubem fungosam formans.

source: Silently, charred shadowy fragments fell from the expanding flames and cloud, like a rain of dust.
target: Silentio, fragmenta umbraculosa et combusta ex flammis expansis et nube ceciderunt, quasi pluvia pulveris.

source: The dust turned pale before touching the ground, some blown by the wind onto the black bird egg.
target: Pulvis, ante terram attingere, pallidum factus est; quidam, vento impulsis, super ovum avium nigrum delabuntur.

source: At that moment, Lumian heard an illusory shattering sound and felt his Reaper potion fully digest.
target: Illo momento, Lumian sonitum fractum et illusorium audivit, atque potionem Reaper suam totam digeri sensit.

source: He had no time to rejoice as his mind and consciousness, protected by the Eggers family’s golden mask, were overwhelmed by fear and dread.
target: Non habuit tempus gaudendi, nam mens eius atque conscientia, a larva aurea familiae Eggers protegente, metu et formido opprimuntur.

source: He lowered his head, knelt to the ground, and hugged himself, trembling.
target: Caput inclinavit, ad terram genu flexit, et se complevit, tremens.

source: He only wanted to obey the orders of the Phoenix Ancestor’s corpse.
target: Solum cupiebat iussa cadaveris Phoenix Antecessoris obsequi.

source: As an undead, he lost his courage, his vision darkening.
target: Ut mortuus iterum ambulans (undead), virtutem amisit, et visus eius obscuratus est.

source: Thump, splash… In extreme fear, Lumian heard the sound of a heartbeat and flowing blood.
target: Tum, splash… In extremo metu, Lumian sonitum cordis pulsationis et sanguinis effluentis audivit.

source: It came from nearby, within this Pale-White Nation.
target: Venit ex proximo, intra hanc Nationem Pallide Albam.

source: It resonated strangely with Lumian.
target: Resonabat insolenter cum Lumiano.

source: Faintly, Lumian heard a mournful cry: “Child!
target: Leniter, Lumian lugubrem clamor audivit: “Puer!

source: “My child!”
target: “Fili mi!”

source: Who is your child? Who are you? Lumian instinctively wondered.
target: Quis puer tuus est? Quis es tu? Lumian instinctu quaerebat.

source: The mournful cry continued:
target: Clamor lugubris pergebat:

source: “My child, where are you?”
target: “Fili mi, ubi es?”

source: The voice paused and then rose slightly:
target: Vox cessavit et deinde leviter surrexit:

source: “Omebella, where are you?”
target: “Omebella, ubi es?”
